archetypes.name: dyn-cli-envelope
archetypes.rationale: Parser envelope and Step 0-pre diagnostics are the riskiest behavior change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design parse-flags entrypoint, validation envelope, and Step 0-pre parsing path. Check that success KVs stay compatible, validation failures preserve rc 3, ERROR_MESSAGE is sourceable, and parse-argv is not left registered. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
